posts.title: Old Prose: "The Catalpa Bow" by Carmen Blacker
posts.description: There are surprisingly few good books on Japanese occult and esoteric traditions in English. You'd think that in a society like ours that's certifiably crazy about anime, not to mention plenty of other aspects of Japanese culture, there would be plenty in print on the abundant and complex lore of Japanese occultism, but that's not the case.
